changelog: First stable release published through the automated build and publish pipeline - No functional firmware changes from 1.0.0
known_issues: FanTRIAC is not included in this firmware. It is a separate compile-only / advanced-preview build (mains-voltage TRIAC dimming), not stable, and remains gated by COMPLIANCE-001 (mains-voltage electrical-safety review).
Sense360 LED is not included in this firmware: the selected configuration 'Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ' does not include LED. The LED-bearing sibling lives on the preview channel.
